title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 — Rabbids With Fleas
Amazed by a dog scratching himself, the Rabbids approach him and get the dog's fleas; at first, they have fun scratching themselves, but quickly try to figure out how to get rid of the pests.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E35 — Rabbidocchio
An old man makes Rabbid-shaped marionettes; the Rabbids waste no time in stealing the puppet, while one of them stays on the premises; the old man mistakes the live Rabbid for his puppet, thinking it has miraculously come to life.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E27 — Flight of the Rabbids
Two Rabbids mistakenly believe that their boss has transformed into a balloon; they pursue a child with a balloon, attempting to rescue their supposed boss.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E12 — True Colors; Recycled Koopa
King Koopa tricks the Mushroom people; junk is dumped into the Mushroom Kingdom.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E13 — The Venice Menace; Super Koopa
Venice is under siege; Kooky Von Koopa makes a magic pendant.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 — Sneaky Lying Cheating Giant Ninja Koopas
Ninja Koopas try to turn a prince into a dog.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E12 — The Missing Link
Ganon comes up with a new wand to counter Link and Zelda's magical weapons' power over his monsters.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E13 — The Moblins Are Revolting
Ganon demonstrates a new wand that makes a bubble around its victim that can only be popped by the Triforce of Power; fed up with Ganon's orders, a Moblin uses the wand to trap Ganon in a bubble and throws him down a bottomless pit.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E1 — The Ringer
Link's only consolation for the boring duty of guarding the Triforce of Wisdom is keeping company with Princess Zelda, who does not feel the same way.

description:
S1 E46 — Poker Face
When Talking Tom loses a bet, The Landlord becomes the new CEO of Tom and Ben Enterprises and turns it into a cleaning company; Talking Ginger decides he's the only one who can make it right.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:

Talking Angela finds herself right in the middle of a basketball fan rivalry.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E46 — Holy Rabbid-Cow!
In the country, a fly fascinates two Rabbids; after unintentionally crushing it in an empty can, they decide to go and catch some of the ones flying around a cow.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E49 — Hypno Rabbid
The Chief Rabbid invents new tasks for the Rabbids; finding a disk with a spiral on it, he makes his troops fan him by making it spin, but ends up hypnotized; the other Rabbids take advantage of this and reverse roles.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E2 — Cold Spells
The first days of spring mark spring-cleaning at Hyrule Castle; Link fakes a cold to avoid chores; Ganon infiltrates the castle and, to create a distraction, covertly augments Sprite's magical powers as she too performs cleaning chores.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E3 — The White Knight
After Link and Zelda are ambushed by monsters, a prince from a neighboring kingdom saves the day, then sweeps the princess off her feet.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E4 — Kiss 'N' Tell
A damsel in distress from a dragon refuses help from Princess Zelda, but after being saved by Link, the lady rewards her hero with a kiss that turns him into a frog.
